status: frozen before PR implementation and performance measurement
steady_training_step: Post-first updates within each repeated fit; retain each fit as one bootstrap block
first_update: Report separately for each repeated fit; may include recurring static-optimizer compilation
complete_fit: Fresh public fit from fixed initial parameters; includes every update, evaluation, finalization and recurring compilation

confidence.main_pr_ratio: Independently resample main and PR fit blocks; runs do not have paired repetition identities
confidence.joint_increment: Independently resample joint-k, joint-(k+1), and added-species independent-fit repetitions
confidence.ambiguity: If the interval crosses a required gate, increase to at least ten fit repetitions; unresolved uncertainty is inconclusive, never a pass

multispecies_fixture.species_zero: Identical to frozen single-species baseline fixture
multispecies_fixture.features: Reuse the same regional feature arrays for all species
multispecies_fixture.sampling_nodes: Sorted NumPy default_rng.choice of patch-grid cells, without replacement, preserving the frozen unit count
multispecies_fixture.targets: 0.2 + Euclidean pixel-position separation / raster side + uniform(0, 0.03) from the same species RNG
multispecies_fixture.pair_sets: All unordered distinct sampling-unit pairs per group, in the frozen label order
multispecies_fixture.fit_initialization: Construct the joint model using frozen model_seed, then initialize every independent species fit with an exact copy of that joint model's initial pooled backbone and that species' projection row. Verify equality before timing. Same seed alone is insufficient. Report any unavoidable initialization mismatch before interpreting timings.
multispecies_fixture.comparison: Every adjacent registry increment 1->2, 2->3, 3->4 versus that added species' independent PR fit; identical data, per-group updates, solver policy, evaluation cadence and finalization
